research_question: Whether each pre-registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system trails the named pick-trader reference under the frozen sota-v3 mechanics, replicating the frozen sota-v2 finding on a new contract fingerprint.

panel_design.selection_rule: Smallest allocation in the predeclared 9-16 seed and 1-3 repeat grid whose conservative-sensitivity familywise all-reject power Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80.
panel_design.result: 16 seeds x 1 repeat (16 episodes/model) at Holm family size 8; sensitivity power 0.8727 with Wilson 95% CI [0.866024, 0.87909] and base power 0.9629 with Wilson 95% CI [0.959014, 0.96643]. The rule's smallest qualifying allocation at family 8 is 15x1 (sensitivity 0.8357, Wilson lower 0.828309); 16 is retained because the pre-data seed commitment is already frozen at 16 seeds.

output_policy.amendment_rule: The common 4,096-token cap is frozen for the strict smoke of every route. If any smoke is truncated or reaches 3,072 output tokens, invalidate all v3 smokes and abort sota-v3 under this contract. Any future run at a different cap requires a new preregistration before model data and a fresh smoke of the entire family. No in-place cap amendment is permitted. Scores and apparent model quality are never cap-selection inputs.

statistical_analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the final registered model family
statistical_analysis_plan.power_definition: Probability every registered Holm-adjusted model-versus-pick-trader contrast rejects when every true lift is -100 score points. The test is two-sided; the sign is a planning assumption drawn from the frozen sota-v2 evidence, not a one-sided test.

power_model.distribution: Normal parametric Monte Carlo over seed-level lifts, evaluated with the production analyzer's exact sign-flip and Holm functions.
power_model.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

statistical_analysis_plan.ranking_rule: No model tiers or ordinal ranking; only each registered model's predeclared contrast versus pick-trader is supported.
statistical_analysis_plan.remaining_blocker: No statistical-design blocker remains before smoke. Panel execution stays blocked until every required strict smoke is accepted under the frozen route, cap, seed, and failure policy.

budget_policy.operator_ceiling_basis: Owner-set hard cap, lowered 150.00 -> 100.00 on 2026-08-06 alongside the amendment-3 cohort reduction to eight reasoning-disabled models. The authoritative current planning forecast and protocol-maximum estimate are generated in the cost artifact named above; amounts are deliberately not duplicated here. The forecast is not a safety reservation: the runner enforces the $100 ceiling dynamically before each provider call, including later interaction rounds and allowed repairs. Cap pressure never authorizes a wider budget or in-place amendment; it aborts this contract and requires a newly costed preregistration.
